trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then strangers and activities, then collectibles and the long grinds — and it unlocks with the final trophy, most often A Long Road or a late collectible.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order; the platinum has no requirement of its own.
Track progress in the checklist above — the audit bar shows 53/55 confirmed and the 2 unconfirmed trophies.
Rockstar's official list confirms the set: 55 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.
Save the long grinds (100%, 250 stunts, WAiNK It x100) for last so the platinum pops on a trophy you control.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission: Lucia and Jason head out on the water and the story begins. It cannot be missed — it is the first mission of the game.

steps.text: Start a new game and play the intro until control passes to Lucia and Jason.
Follow the on-screen objective marker to the boat and board it.
Complete the fishing beat — cast, hook and reel in as prompted.
Rockstar's launch notes name Gone Fishing as the opening mission of the game.
Finish the mission's closing cutscene; the trophy pops on the results screen.
If you skip cutscenes, the mission still counts — the trophy is tied to completion, not viewing.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter progress is shown in the pause menu, so you can see exactly which missions remain.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 1 mission strand in order; side content is optional for this trophy.
Check the pause menu's chapter list after each mission to confirm the next one unlocked.
Complete the chapter's final mission — the chapter card marks it as the finale.
Watch for the chapter-complete banner; the trophy pops with it.
Replay any failed mission from the pause menu — failure never locks a chapter trophy.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. The chapter introduces the drug-trade strand — play its missions in order and the trophy pops at the finale.

steps.text: Start Chapter 2 from the story strand that opens after Chapter 1.
Complete each mission in the chapter's strand; the pause menu lists them.
Do the strand's setup jobs before the finale — they gate the last mission.
Finish the chapter finale mission to trigger the chapter-complete banner.
The trophy pops on the results screen, even if you skip the closing cutscene.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3, the Vice City chapter. The city opens up fully here — the trophy only needs the chapter's missions, not exploration.

steps.text: Follow the Chapter 3 strand markers across Vice City in order.
Complete the mid-chapter set-piece mission; it unlocks the second half of the chapter.
Finish the remaining strand missions listed in the pause menu.
Complete the chapter finale to trigger the chapter-complete banner.
The trophy pops on the results screen, regardless of mission medals.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4, the toughest story chapter. Stock up on armour and ammo before the finale — its firefights are the heaviest so far.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 strand in order; side missions stay optional.
Buy armour and restock ammo before the chapter's big shootout missions.
Use cover and Combat Focus in the finale's extended gunfight.
Complete the chapter finale to trigger the chapter-complete banner.
The trophy pops on the results screen, even on a low medal.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. It unlocks after Chapter 4 — finish it and the credits roll with a gold trophy.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 4 to unlock the final mission marker.
Stock armour, ammo and snacks before starting — the finale is long with checkpoints.
Follow the finale's objectives; checkpoints save progress between sections.
Finish the last objective and watch the ending; the trophy pops as the credits begin.
Rockstar confirmed the story ends with the final mission and free roam stays open after the credits.
Post-story free roam stays open, so nothing is missable after the finale.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission. It is a story mission — follow its objectives to the end and the trophy pops.

steps.text: Start Breakfast Run from its story marker when it appears.
Drive to each objective in order; the route is marked on the minimap.
Complete the mission's pickup and delivery beats without abandoning the vehicle.
Finish the closing beat of the mission to reach the results screen.
The trophy pops on mission completion, regardless of medal.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission — a planned robbery with setup beats and a getaway. Keep your crew alive through the escape for the smoothest run.

steps.text: Start The Cartel Heist from its story marker.
Complete the setup beats first — they gate the heist itself.
During the robbery, follow the marked route and keep moving.
Lose the wanted level on the getaway leg to reach the safe point.
The trophy pops on the results screen once the heist completes.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. It is a story mission — play it through to the end.

steps.text: Start Child's Play from its story marker.
Follow the objective chain; the mission mixes driving and on-foot beats.
Protect the family member the mission centers on during the escort beat.
Finish the final beat to reach the results screen.
The trophy pops on mission completion, regardless of medal.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. A story mission with a headline-grabbing set piece — finish it and the trophy pops.

steps.text: Start Headliners from its story marker.
Complete the opening setup beats before the main event.
Follow the marked objectives through the set-piece sequence.
Finish the closing beat to reach the results screen.
The trophy pops on mission completion, regardless of medal.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission at the airport. Expect heavy security — use cover and keep to the marked route through the terminal area.

steps.text: Start VCIA Takedown from its story marker.
Enter the airport grounds via the marked route, not the main gates.
Clear the takedown target's guards with cover and Combat Focus.
Complete the takedown and the escape leg to the safe point.
The trophy pops on the results screen once the mission completes.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a large-scale story operation. It is one of the longest missions — checkpoints carry you through its sections.

steps.text: Start Operation Savage Glory from its story marker.
Stock armour and heavy ammo before the operation begins.
Work through the operation's sections in order; checkpoints save between them.
Use vehicles for the operation's transport legs to save time.
The trophy pops on the results screen once the operation completes.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the gold trophy and usually the last one before the platinum. The in-game checklist shows every requirement; story, strangers, activities, collectibles and stunts all feed it.

steps.text: Open the 100% checklist in the pause menu and note every unfinished line.
Finish the story, all stranger strands and all activities first — they are the bulk of the list.
Rockstar's 100% checklist covers story, strangers, activities and collectibles — no hidden requirements.
Clear the collectibles (cards, WAiNK It spots, vehicles) with the atlas markers in this guide.
Finish the 250 stunts and 50 challenges; they are checklist lines too.
Check the checklist percentage after each session — it updates per requirement, not per trophy.
The trophy pops the moment the checklist hits 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, wheelies, drifts and air time all count. Farm them in short bursts between missions rather than in one sitting.

steps.text: Pick a fast car or bike and a long straight with ramps or jumps nearby.
Chain air time, near misses and drifts — each distinct stunt adds to the counter.
Use the airport runway for repeatable jumps with a long landing run.
Check the stats page to confirm the stunt counter is climbing.
Mix stunt types — repeating one type still counts, but variety fills the counter faster per run.
The trophy pops at stunt 250, mid-session.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once each: racing, fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and golf-style mini-games are the usual set — the activities menu lists them.

steps.text: Open the activities menu and list the 9 types; tick each as you try it.
Win or finish one race of any kind for the racing type.
Catch one fish, finish one arcade game and bowl one frame for three types at once.
Try the shooting range, a drone race and a meditation spot for three more.
Hunt one animal and finish the remaining activity type on the list.
The trophy pops when the ninth type registers — winning is not required, trying is.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the hardest skill trophy — learn each range's pattern, then grind golds one weapon class at a time.

steps.text: Visit a Shooting Range and open the challenge list — 42 challenges across weapon classes.
Start with pistols and SMGs; their gold times are the most forgiving.
Learn the target order per challenge before chasing the gold time.
Use Combat Focus to steady aim on the timed precision challenges.
Replay a challenge immediately after a near miss — the pattern is identical each run.
Track golds in the range menu; the count must reach 42.
The trophy pops when the 42nd gold medal is earned.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own course — learn the gates, then race clean.

steps.text: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race markers on the atlas in this guide.
Fly the course once slowly to learn the gate order before racing.
Cut corners only where gates allow — missing a gate costs more than the shortcut saves.
Win each location once; the race menu shows which locations are still unwon.
Retry a lost race on the spot — the course and rivals are the same each attempt.
The trophy pops when the 14th location is won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each distinct race event counts once. Mix street, off-road and circuit races to reach 20 quickly.

steps.text: Open the race list and pick the shortest events first.
Use a tuned car in its class — mismatched classes make wins harder.
Win each race once; repeats of the same event do not add to the 20.
Try street races in Vice City and off-road races outside it for variety.
The trophy pops on the 20th distinct race win.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spot, take the challenge, and out-fish him within the time limit.

steps.text: Go to the fishing spot marked on the atlas and find Cal.
Talk to Cal to start the fishing challenge.
Cast where fish are showing and reel steadily — don't let the line snap.
Land more weight than Cal before the timer ends.
If Cal wins, rechallenge him at once — the challenge restarts immediately.
The trophy pops when you beat Cal's total.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at any arcade cabinet. Pick the shortest cabinet game and play it to the end.

steps.text: Find an arcade cabinet — arcades are marked on the atlas.
Pick the shortest game on the cabinet menu.
Play through to the game's end screen.
A loss does not count — you must complete the game.
The trophy pops on the completion screen.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's stranger strand through to its final mission. Stranger markers appear as you explore — follow Andy's strand to the end.

steps.text: Find Andy's first stranger marker and start his strand.
Complete each Andy mission in order; later ones unlock after earlier ones.
Check the strangers list in the pause menu if a marker disappears.
Finish Andy's final mission to close the strand.
The trophy pops on the final mission's results screen.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's stranger strand through to its final mission — a boat-heavy strand, so keep a fast boat handy.

steps.text: Find Kenton's first stranger marker near the water and start his strand.
Complete each Kenton mission in order.
Use a fast boat for the strand's water legs.
Finish Kenton's final mission to close the strand.
The trophy pops on the final mission's results screen.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's stranger strand through to its final mission — a lone-rider strand built around bikes.

steps.text: Find Billy's first stranger marker and start his strand.
Complete each Billy mission in order, on a bike where the mission provides one.
Keep a fast bike owned for the strand's riding legs.
Finish Billy's final mission to close the strand.
The trophy pops on the final mission's results screen.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger strands across Leonida. There are more than 8 strands in the state — pick the shortest eight and finish each one.

steps.text: Open the strangers list and note every strand available in the state.
Start with the short strands — Andy, Kenton and Billy are good openers.
Finish one strand fully before starting the next to keep the count clear.
Add Randy's and Tyrone's strands to the count when their markers appear.
Check the strangers list after each strand — completed strands show as done.
Pick any three more strands from the list to reach eight.
The trophy pops when the eighth strand completes.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's stranger strand through to its final mission — a supply-run strand, so a roomy vehicle helps.

steps.text: Find Randy's first stranger marker and start his strand.
Complete each Randy mission in order.
Use a van or truck for the strand's supply runs.
Finish Randy's final mission to close the strand.
The trophy pops on the final mission's results screen.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's stranger strand through to its final mission.

steps.text: Find Tyrone's first stranger marker and start his strand.
Complete each Tyrone mission in order.
Follow the strand's marked objectives; its later missions are driving-heavy.
Finish Tyrone's final mission to close the strand.
The trophy pops on the final mission's results screen.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. MISSABLE: some spots sit in areas that change after story beats, so do this before the final mission — use the atlas markers and tick each spot off as you go.

steps.text: Open the atlas in this guide — all 18 meditation spots are marked.
Do this BEFORE the final story mission; spots can become unreachable after story beats.
Visit each spot and meditate until the prompt completes.
Work region by region — Vice City, the Keys and the mainland — to avoid backtracking.
Tick each spot in the checklist as you finish it.
The meditation counter in the stats page confirms how many spots remain.
The trophy pops at the 18th meditation.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Find Bret, take the hunt, and track the animal to its territory.

steps.text: Find Bret and start the hunt strand.
Go to the hunting grounds marked on the atlas.
Track the unique animal from its signs — tracks and calls mark the trail.
Use a scoped rifle and shoot from cover; the animal flees if it spots you.
Return the kill to Bret to close the hunt.
The trophy pops when Bret accepts the hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — collect a full set's cards and the set completes.

steps.text: Open the cards menu to see each set and how many cards it needs.
Pick the three smallest sets first — they need the fewest cards.
Use the atlas markers in this guide for card locations, region by region.
Cards glow and ping when you are near — sweep each marked spot on foot.
A set completes the moment its last card is picked up.
Repeat for two more sets; duplicates do not count toward a set.
The trophy pops when the third set completes.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — the long photo grind. The WAiNK app marks spots; photograph each one and the counter climbs.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app and note the nearest unphotographed spots.
Photograph each spot from the marked angle — the app confirms the shot.
Work through Vice City first, then the Keys and mainland, to cut travel.
Check the WAiNK counter in the app after each session.
Spots already done show as complete in the app — never re-shoot one.
The trophy pops at the 100th WAiNK It photo.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges span driving, combat, exploration and activities — clear the easy ones first and the count builds fast.

steps.text: Open the challenges menu and sort by easiest first.
Clear the driving and exploration challenges early — they complete during normal play.
Do the combat challenges in free roam with a wanted level for fast progress.
Check the challenge counter after each session.
Save the long challenges (stunts, races) for dedicated sessions.
The trophy pops on the 50th completed challenge.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then lose it and escape. Do it in the countryside where police are thin.

steps.text: Bring your partner along — the trophy needs both of you in the escape.
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars by attacking police or causing chaos.
Drive out of the city into the countryside where patrols are thin.
Hide in alleys or off-road until the wanted stars blink and clear.
Stay with your partner until the level fully clears.
The trophy pops the moment the 4-star level is lost.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your wanted level. Pick three shops close together, move fast, and never let the level drop between robberies.

steps.text: Pick three shops on the same street so travel between them is seconds.
Bring your partner — the trophy requires them present for all three.
Rob the first shop and leave immediately for the second.
Keep your wanted level alive between shops — do not hide or lose it.
Rob the second and third shops the same way, back-to-back.
The trophy pops after the third robbery with the level intact.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new model you drive counts — cruise varied neighbourhoods and hop into anything you have not driven.

steps.text: Drive through varied areas — city, suburbs, docks and countryside spawn different models.
Get in and drive each new model briefly; discovery registers on entry.
Check the vehicles menu to see which models are still undiscovered.
Visit car parks, dealerships and the airport for rare models.
Missions and stranger strands introduce models you would not meet in free roam.
The trophy pops at the 100th discovered vehicle.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one Combat Focus. Trigger it in a busy gunfight with enemies grouped close together.

steps.text: Find a gunfight with at least 5 enemies in one area.
Wait until the enemies group up before triggering Combat Focus.
Trigger Combat Focus and take the enemies down one by one while it lasts.
Headshots drop enemies fastest inside the window.
If you fall short, retry the same fight — enemy placement is identical.
The trophy pops when the fifth enemy drops inside one Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — steal a plane and take off without clearance. The airport is marked on the atlas.

steps.text: Go to VCIA airport, marked on the atlas.
Enter the airfield via a side gate to avoid the main security.
Steal a plane on the runway or apron.
Take off without waiting for clearance — that is the unscheduled departure.
Stay airborne briefly to confirm the departure registered.
The trophy pops once you are airborne off-schedule.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. Survive a Rhino encounter and destroy or escape one.

steps.text: Raise a high wanted level to draw a Rhino tank response.
Keep moving — a Rhino's cannon one-shots most vehicles.
Use sticky bombs or heavy weapons on the Rhino's rear.
Destroy the Rhino or escape its patrol area to end the encounter.
The trophy pops when the Rhino encounter resolves.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — no alarms, no witnesses calling it in. Go at night, move quietly, and leave before security responds.

steps.text: Pick a jewelry store from the atlas markers.
Go at night when foot traffic is lowest.
Enter quietly and avoid the clerk's line of sight until you are ready.
Smash the cases fast and grab the loot without tripping the alarm.
Leave through the back or side exit, not the front door.
If spotted, leave and retry — detection fails the attempt, not the trophy.
The trophy pops when you escape undetected with the loot.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the biggest robberies — plan the getaway before you go in.

steps.text: Find the five bank vault locations from the atlas markers.
Scout each bank first — note exits and police routes.
Bring armour, heavy weapons and a fast getaway car parked nearby.
Crack the vault, grab the cash and leave before the response arrives.
Lose the wanted level after each vault to bank the robbery.
Repeat for all five vaults; each escape counts separately.
The trophy pops after the fifth vault escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Block the truck, crack it open, grab the cash and lose the heat.

steps.text: Find an armored truck route — they run set routes through the city.
Block the truck with your vehicle to force it to stop.
Deal with the guards, then crack the rear doors open.
Grab the cash and get moving before backup arrives.
Lose the wanted level to bank the robbery.
The trophy pops once the escape is complete.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive or fly through every named area — the map fills in as you go.

steps.text: Open the map and note the areas still greyed out.
Drive the coast road to cover Vice City, the Keys and the beach towns.
Rockstar's Leonida map names 52 areas across Vice City, the Keys and the mainland.
Fly or drive inland for the swamps, farmland and mountain areas.
Enter each area's centre — edge passes sometimes do not register.
Use a plane to sweep remote areas quickly.
Check the explored count in the stats page.
The trophy pops when the 52nd area registers.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs operations in its own turf — hit one per gang.

steps.text: Learn the 9 gangs and their turf from the atlas markers in this guide.
Scout one illegal operation per gang before hitting it.
Bring heavy weapons — operations are guarded.
Rob the operation and escape with the take.
Lose the wanted level to bank each robbery.
Track the gangs in the checklist — hit gangs show as done.
The trophy pops after the ninth gang's operation is robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact trigger is still being verified by the community. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: order one at a beachfront bar and enjoy the view. If it does not pop, try a different beachfront bar or time of day.

steps.text: Go to Ocean Beach, marked on the atlas.
Find a beachfront bar with a cocktail on the menu.
Order a cocktail and stay at the bar with the ocean view.
If nothing pops, try another beachfront bar or come back at sunset.
This trophy is marked unconfirmed in the audit bar until the trigger is verified.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass.

steps.text: Find a vehicle showroom from the atlas markers.
Pick a fast car and line it up with the showroom glass.
Drive straight through the glass and out the other side.
Keep your speed up — a slow push may not count as a smash.
Lose any wanted level after the smash if police respond.
The trophy pops on the smash-out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley — follow through on a full game.

steps.text: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, marked on the atlas.
Start a bowling game at the counter.
Bowl a full game — follow through on every frame.
Aim for the pocket and adjust for the lane's drift.
The trophy pops when the game completes.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — this pops during a story beat with your partner. It is tied to story progress, not a side activity.

steps.text: Play the story strand that builds the partnership.
Complete the missions that raise the partnership's profile.
The trophy pops during the story beat — no extra action is needed.
If it has not popped, continue the story strand; it is progression-tied.
The trophy pops on the story beat's completion.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices across the game — dialogue choices, mission approach choices and free-roam decisions all feed the count.

steps.text: Pick dialogue options whenever they appear — each one counts.
Vary mission approaches where the game offers a choice.
Free-roam decisions (help or rob, spare or finish) also count.
Check the choices counter in the stats page.
The count builds across the whole playthrough — it is not per-mission.
The trophy pops at choice 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the exact trigger is still being verified by the community. The description suggests succeeding on a second try after a first failure — fail an activity once, then succeed at the same activity on the immediate retry.

steps.text: Pick a repeatable activity — a race or a shooting challenge works.
Fail the activity once on purpose.
Retry the same activity immediately and succeed.
If it does not pop, try a different activity the same way.
This trophy is marked unconfirmed in the audit bar until the trigger is verified.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — Leonida hides weird encounters. Explore odd map markers and remote spots until one triggers.

steps.text: Explore remote and odd spots on the map — the strange encounters hide there.
Visit the swamps and the desert edges at night.
Follow any strange lights, sounds or markers you find.
Stay until the event plays out — leaving early can fail the trigger.
Try different in-game times if a spot shows nothing.
The trophy pops when the strange event completes.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl them over.

steps.text: Equip a melee weapon — a bat works best.
Find a pedestrian on a quiet street.
Drive past slowly and swing the melee weapon from the vehicle.
Hit the pedestrian cleanly to knock them down.
A slow drive-by is easier to aim than a fast one.
The trophy pops on the knockdown.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists — launder them in batches through contacts.

steps.text: Collect marked bills from robberies, vaults and heists.
Open the contacts menu and find the laundering contact.
Launder bills in batches — the contact takes a cut per batch.
Larger batches launder faster but draw more heat.
Check the laundered total in the economy stats.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades all count — spend naturally and top up with big purchases at the end.

steps.text: Buy weapons and ammo first — they are the fastest big spends.
Buy clothes and car upgrades to spread spending across shop types.
Check the spent total in the economy stats.
A car purchase closes most of the remaining gap in one go.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Save up, then buy them region by region.

steps.text: Open the property menu to see all 8 garages and their prices.
Buy the cheapest garages first to start the count.
Earn the cash from heists and laundering if you are short.
Garages are spread across the city, Keys and mainland — travel between buys.
Check the property count after each purchase.
The trophy pops on the eighth garage purchase.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, photograph or scan them into the app, and the count climbs.

steps.text: Open the Scooter Bros app and read how registration works.
Find a vehicle you have not registered yet.
Register it through the app on the spot.
Varied models register fastest — duplicates do not count.
Check the registered count in the app.
The trophy pops at the 10th registered vehicle.
